guidedPractice.prompt: First find the target in context. Then make a parallel attempt from a cue; the completed response remains hidden until after the attempt.

progressiveHints.text: Choose one situation where you would naturally use plain verb and copula forms; do not write the whole sentence yet.
Build the sentence in parts: choose the content first, then check the form that carries shift familiar statements between polite and plain style.
Compare your form, meaning, and plain style for close, informal contexts; polite style for formal interaction with the worked model. Change the content so the response is your own.

retryFeedback.diagnostic: Check the form and meaning again. A common mix-up is this: plain style is not automatically rude, but it needs the right relationship and setting
retryFeedback.retryPrompt: Revise one part at a time, then try again with your own content.
